<!-- Generated by plugin-tools build-ports from commands/agent-tools.md. -->
Prepare these artifacts to be called by AI agents through Logic Conductor: (the text the user gave after the skill's name)

Follow the `logic-fabric-dataverse:artifacts` skill's [agent tools reference](../skills/artifacts/reference/agent-tools.md).
Outside a change this is a small change of its own: if `logic-fabric/.active` is empty, start one with
`/logic-fabric-dataverse:start` as a quick change so the edits go through validation, review and the gate.

1. If nothing is named, list the project's flows, blocks and processes (`find`) and propose the ones an agent
   should use: business-level operations and read-only lookups, not internal helpers. Agree the list.
2. For each, read it (`get`) and propose: a description written for an agent; a `metaInfo.description` for every
   input (choice values from `schema`, business keys rather than IDs); a precondition if it has none (it becomes an
   entry point); a test of one agent-style call by business key.
3. After the owner agrees, build it like any task (`validate`, `save`, `test`), then `release` `action: "expose"`.
   In test and production an administrator switches on **Expose as MCP tool**.
